skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Design and implement distinctive, polished frontend experiences for web components, pages, and applications.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives. Their cited lines contain frontend design guidance and do not request system reconnaissance or unsafe actions.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 asks for production-grade interface implementation and aesthetic attention. It contains no system inspection, environment discovery, or reconnaissance instruction.
Line 30 recommends distinctive typography and font pairing. This is visual design guidance without any request to inspect the host system.
Line 34 lists decorative background techniques such as textures and shadows. It does not direct system enumeration, data access, or external communication.

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces often lack a clear visual identity and thoughtful interaction details. This skill turns frontend requirements into polished, functional implementations with a deliberate aesthetic.
actual_capabilities: Creates working interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue.
Selects a clear visual direction based on audience, purpose, and constraints.
Defines cohesive typography, color, spacing, composition, and background treatments.
Adds purposeful animations, hover states, and page transitions.
Uses CSS variables and responsive layout techniques for consistent implementation.
Adjusts implementation detail to suit minimalist or maximalist design directions.
limitations: It needs clear product goals, audience details, and technical constraints for the strongest results.
It does not replace accessibility testing, browser testing, or performance profiling.
Suggested fonts and libraries may require separate installation, licensing, or availability checks.
Visual recommendations still require review against an existing brand system.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a memorable responsive page that presents product value through focused typography, layout, color, and motion.

use_cases.title: Refine an Application Interface
use_cases.description: Improve an existing dashboard with clearer hierarchy, cohesive styling, purposeful states, and polished interactions.

use_cases.title: Build Reusable Components
use_cases.description: Implement distinctive components that respect framework constraints while maintaining visual consistency and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a responsive portfolio page for [audience] using [framework]. Choose one clear visual direction and include accessible navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Focused Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a polished [component] for [product]. Define its states, responsive behavior, typography, colors, and one purposeful interaction.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign the provided [page] for [audience]. Preserve required behavior while improving hierarchy, differentiation, responsiveness, and interaction quality.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Complete Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production-ready [application] in [framework]. Establish a distinctive system for tokens, layouts, components, motion, accessibility, and responsive states.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive landing page for an independent architecture studio.
output_examples.output: A working editorial page with strong project imagery, restrained typography, asymmetric composition, responsive navigation, and subtle reveal transitions.

output_examples.input: Improve a dense analytics dashboard without changing its data model.
output: A clearer information hierarchy with stable dashboard regions.
Consistent chart, filter, table, and status treatments.
Responsive layouts and purposeful loading, empty, and hover states.

output_examples.input: Build a React pricing section for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: A distinctive responsive pricing comparison with accessible controls, clear plan emphasis, cohesive tokens, and focused interaction feedback.

best_practices: Provide the audience, purpose, framework, brand constraints, and required interactions.
Request accessibility, responsiveness, and application states as explicit acceptance criteria.
Review generated dependencies, assets, performance, and browser behavior before release.
anti_patterns: Do not request visual styling without explaining the product context or audience.
Do not prioritize novelty over usability, accessibility, or content clarity.
Do not accept generated fonts, libraries, or assets without checking availability and licenses.

faq.question: Which frontend technologies does this skill support?
faq.answer: It can guide implementations using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar web frameworks.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing interface?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current implementation, required behavior, and constraints so it can refine design and interaction details.

faq.question: Does it create responsive designs?
faq.answer: Yes. Responsive behavior should be included in the request and verified across the required viewport sizes.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessibility compliance?
faq.answer: No. It can apply accessible patterns, but formal testing and expert review remain necessary.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply tokens, components, brand rules, and examples to keep the implementation consistent.

faq.question: Will it choose external fonts or libraries?
faq.answer: It may recommend them when appropriate. Confirm licensing, installation, availability, bundle impact, and project compatibility before release.
